"""Search over sets of paths that are already 'core-like' (no peripheral link)."""
import itertools, random, sys, time
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp')
import reference
exec(open('/workspace/tmp/findzero4.py').read().split("rng = random.Random")[0].replace("import random, sys, itertools, time",""))

def is_core_like(paths):
    """True when no link is peripheral in the path set."""
    for e, ps in ((e, [p for p in paths if e in reference.links_of(p)])
                  for e in set().union(*[reference.links_of(p) for p in paths])):
        for endpoint in e:
            if all((p[0] == endpoint or p[-1] == endpoint) for p in ps):
                return False
    return True

rng = random.Random(int(sys.argv[1]) if len(sys.argv)>1 else 1)
t0=time.time(); found=0; trials=0
while time.time()-t0 < 120:
    trials += 1
    nasn = rng.randint(4,6)
    asns = list(range(1,nasn+1))
    paths=[]
    for _ in range(rng.randint(3,6)):
        L = rng.randint(3,6)
        p=[]
        for _ in range(L):
            a=rng.choice(asns)
            if p and p[-1]==a: continue
            p.append(a)
        if len(set(p))!=len(p) or len(p)<3: continue
        paths.append(tuple(p))
    paths=list(dict.fromkeys(paths))
    if len(paths)<3: continue
    if not is_core_like(paths): continue
    core_paths,_ = reference.peel({p:1 for p in paths})
    if set(core_paths) != set(paths): continue
    core, occ = build(core_paths)
    if len(core)>8: continue
    if satisfiable(core,occ): continue
    Z = reference.marginals(core_paths)[2]
    print('Z =', Z, 'paths', paths)
    found += 1
    if found>=3: break
print('trials',trials,'found',found)
PYEOF
